items.title: UK biotechs struggling to access finance as scale-up concerns grow
items.summary: The UK Government has prioritised life science sector growth, but industry members have called for more funding.

items.title: Novartis to acquire Myricx Bio in up to $1.5bn deal
items.summary: Novartis has signed an agreement to purchase Myricx Bio, a UK-based biotechnology company, in a transaction valued at up to $1.5bn.

items.title: Roche pens $490m Astex breast cancer license deal
items.summary: Roche’s breast cancer agreement with Astex is one of several oncology deals the Swiss pharma giant has inked in recent years.

items.title: Besins Healthcare boosts drug delivery portfolio with UniD deal
items.summary: Besins Healthcare has expanded its pharmaceutical operations with the acquisition of UniD Manufacturing, which specialises in long-acting drug delivery technologies.

items.title: Between two giants: Europe’s new oncology chapter takes shape in Paris
items.summary: Paris is emerging as a focal point for Europe’s next phase in oncology, as science, capital and industry converge at Campus Grand Parc.
